skill2: When attacking an enemy projectile, damage to that projectile ▲ 7.74% continuously.
burst: Damage dealt by Wind Code enemies ▼ 90.72% for 30 sec. Activates 1 time(s) per battle.

caveats: ⚑ The burst Interruption-Parts block's kit gate ('Activates when Cherry Blossom Tea is at max stacks') is NOT enforced — no stack-count resource is declared, so the block fires on every burst cast. Damage-inert either way: partsDamagePct is a no-op on the partless scope-lock boss, so the un-gated model moves zero damage. If parts damage ever becomes live, this MUST be gated (declare a 'cherryBlossomTea' resource + resourceGate min:10) before it is trusted.

⚑ defPct is engine-inert in v1 (self DEF does not feed own damage); the Cherry Blossom Tea stack buff is carried for kit completeness and as the semantic source of the burst's max-stacks gate, not for damage.

⚑ Cadence inputs (ammo 6, reloadFrames 121, chargeFrames 60, rate-of-fire) come from the known-unreliable datamine fields; the skill1 hitCount:3 activation rate — and therefore whether 10 stacks are ever reached inside the rolling 15s window — rides entirely on them.

The only mechanically damage-relevant line in the whole kit is the skill2 full-burst-enter burstCdr (4.84s, all allies), which shortens the TEAM's rotation, plus the burst's 10s caster-scaled ATK grant. Everything else is defensive, projectile-scoped, parts-scoped, or DEF.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Sakura (SR/Fire/Supporter/Burst I, cd 40s). Modeled: S1 'Cherry Blossom Tea' as an allies DEF ▲8.15% stack buff (hitCount:3 — 'after 3 normal attack(s)', counted in ROUNDS, not trigger pulls; maxStacks 10, 15s, refreshing). S2 full-burst-enter allies burstCdr 4.84s (a real rotation lever — it accelerates every ally's burst cooldown on EVERY team Full Burst, not just rotations Sakura bursts on; the kit text says 'entering Full Burst', so it is keyed to fullBurstEnter, not burstCast). Burst: allies ATK ▲23.76% of the skill user's ATK for 10s (casterAtkPct — flat-resolved off Sakura's own staticAtk at apply time, so a Supporter-class caster grants a modest flat add), plus allies Damage to Interruption Parts ▲23.54% for 30s (partsDamagePct, inert on a partless boss, gate not enforced — see caveats). Deliberately unmodeled: the S2 enemy-projectile damage line (no enemy projectiles exist in the sim) and the burst's Wind-Code incoming-damage reduction (purely defensive; the sim models no incoming damage). Both are recorded verbatim in `unmodeled`.

flags.estimate: SR, ammo 6, chargeFrames 60 (1.0s full charge), reloadFrames 121 (~2.0s). ⇒ roughly one shot per ~1.0–1.3s while firing, ~2.0s reload every 6 shots ⇒ ~1 activation per ~3.5–4.5s.
flags.reasoning: Base-stat cadence fields (rate_of_fire, reloadFrames, chargeFrames) are the known-unreliable datamine surface, and the whole S1 stack trajectory hangs off them. The trigger itself is kit-literal ('after 3 normal attack(s)') — only the RATE is ⚑.
flags.recipe: Count Sakura's shots in a recording over a fixed 15s window (ammo counter 6→0→reload) and compare to the sim's shotFired event count for the same window; correct pullsPerSec / reload if they disagree.

flags.field: override.skill1[0] — Cherry Blossom Tea stack steady-state
flags.estimate: ⚑ Reaching the 10-stack cap requires 30 rounds inside a rolling 15s window. At the cadence above (~11–15 rounds per 15s) the realistic steady state is ~4–5 stacks, and the 10-stack cap is likely NEVER reached solo. NOT authored at max magnitude (value is per-stack, 8.15, with maxStacks:10) so the engine accrues the real trajectory — no rampSec haircut applied.
flags.reasoning: Per the stack/currency prior: derive the trajectory from the stated accrual (3 rounds/stack) against the stated 15s lifetime. This estimate is what makes the burst's 'at max stacks' gate suspicious — if the cap is unreachable, that burst branch may be effectively dead outside multi-hit/team-fed conditions.
flags.recipe: DBG_BUFFS=1 on a solo run: log buffApply stacks for the defPct key over 180s and read the observed steady-state stack count; cross-check against buff-icon stack numbers in footage.

flags.field: override.burst[1] — missing 'Cherry Blossom Tea at max stacks' gate
flags.estimate: ⚑ Ungated (fires on every burst cast). Correct model would be a declared resource + resourceGate {name:'cherryBlossomTea', min:10}; per the flag above the gate would likely be FALSE most or all of the fight.
flags.reasoning: The schema's resourceGate reads a `resources` pool, not a stacking buff's stack count, and there is no faithful way to make a monotonic resource mirror a 15s-decaying stack without over-crediting. Left ungated deliberately because partsDamagePct is inert on the partless boss ⇒ zero damage delta either way; recorded here so it cannot ship silently if parts ever become live.
flags.recipe: If parts damage is ever modeled: declare resources:[{name:'cherryBlossomTea', initial:0, min:0, max:10}], add a resource +1 effect to the skill1 block, model decay, then gate this block. Until then, verify the block is damage-neutral by an A/B with the block removed (expect an exact 0.00% delta).

flags.field: override.skill2[0] — burstCdr trigger identity (fullBurstEnter vs burstCast)
flags.estimate: ⚑ Keyed to fullBurstEnter per the literal text ('Activates when entering Full Burst'), i.e. it fires on EVERY team Full Burst including rotations Sakura does not cast on.
flags.reasoning: Trigger identity is the highest-leverage divergence in this kit: this is the only line that moves damage, and it does so through rotation. burstCast would fire strictly less often in a multi-Burst-I comp; fullBurstEnter is the faithful literal read, but the two diverge in exactly the comps a Burst I unit is used in.
flags.recipe: Measure full-burst COUNT over 180s in a real fight with Sakura vs the same comp without her; the FB-count delta discriminates a per-FB 4.84s CDR from a per-own-cast one. FB counts are deterministic cooldown arithmetic, so a single clean recording is decisive.

flags.estimate: ⚑ Resolves to 0.2376 × Sakura's staticAtk (Supporter @ Base 5 ≈ 98,367 ⇒ ~23.4k flat ATK to each ally), applied as a flat add, for 10s per burst cast.
flags.reasoning: The harness flat-resolves caster-scaled values at apply time, so the emitted buffApply value is a flat ATK number, not 23.76. Flagged so any downstream assertion checks the flat number, not the kit percentage — and because the Supporter-class ATK anchor is the input, a wrong class basis silently mis-sizes the whole burst.
flags.recipe: Assert the buffApply event's value ≈ 0.2376 × 98367 with stat 'casterAtkPct' in a controlComp run; confirm the class ATK anchor against data/reference-stats.json.
